title: What if you stood on a neutron star? 💫
subject: star
description:
Would you rather visit a neutron star or a black hole? 👇

A neutron star packs up to 2 Suns into a ball the size of a city. Here is what its gravity would do to you, from a sugar cube that weighs as much as a mountain to an impact bigger than every nuclear weapon on Earth.

Sources: NASA Science, "Neutron Stars Are Weird!"; Live Science, "What Is a Neutron Star?" (Adam Mann, 2019); ScienceAlert, "An Encounter With a Neutron Star Would Dwarf Our Entire Nuclear Arsenal" (Phil Plait's estimate, 2017).
tags: what if you stood on a neutron star

scenes.text: On a neutron star, you'd weigh 2 billion times more.
It's a collapsed star: up to 2 Suns crushed into a ball 12 miles wide.
NASA says one sugar cube of it would weigh 1 billion tons.
The fastest one, in the cluster Terzan 5, spins 43,000 times a minute.
You'd never stand. Gravity would drag you down at two-thirds the speed of light.
Astronomer Phil Plait figured your impact would release more energy than all of Earth's nukes.
